newsitem.title: USA: Zytec cites higher SG&A expenses.
newsitem.headline: Zytec cites higher SG&A expenses.

text.p: Zytec Corp, reporting lower fourth-quarter earnings, attributed the decline primarily to the result of higher sales and general administrative expenses incurred to support expected continued growth.
It said SG&A expenses rose to 4.6 percent of sales in 1996, compared with 4.2 percent of sales in 1995.

The company, a designer and manufacturer of custom electronic power conversion equipment, said research and development expenses in 1996 were $9.5 million, up $866,000 over 1996, but down to 4.1 percent of sales from five percent of sales in 1995.
Zytec posted earnings of $0.17 a share, down from $0.21 for the quarter. For the full year, it earned $1.04, which included $0.26 a share from recognition of a tax benefit, compared to $0.42 a share.
